dz: 在卡农图姆，名誉皇帝戴克里先与东方奥古斯都加莱里乌斯和最近回归的西方前奥古斯都马克西米努斯商议，试图结束四帝制的内战。
de: At Carnuntum, Emperor emeritus Diocletian confers with Galerius, Augustus of the East, and Maximianus, the recently returned former Augustus of the West, in an attempt to end the civil wars of the Tetrarchy.
